text:
raj: Following up on the KV eviction postmortem 481
We need concrete owners for the testing work and clear recurrence so this doesn't slip. Suggest splitting into three deliverables: (A) scenario-driven regression pack, (B) eviction-focused promptset + metadata, (C) load soak + mini chaos drill. Who volunteers?
elaine: I can lead the scenario pack (A). Will design ~30 scenario families that exercise prefix overlap, long history, and interleaved writes. Aim to prototype runner + examples in 10 days.
ben: I'll wire the CI glue. Plan: a sampled matrix for daily checks and a full sweep weekly. Will add cost caps and a fail-open flag for infra flakiness. ETA 12 days.
susan: Ops will run the soak + chaos (C). Need a checklist: pre-run baselines, signal channels, rollback ETA, and a marker for KV eviction threshold. I'll schedule staging run and a postmortem template. Dry run next Tue morning.
linda: I'll curate the promptset (B) 150-250 prompts covering boundary truncation, rapid prefix switching, and tokenized aliasing. Also add tags for reproducibility (seed, model config). Target in 6 days.
raj: Good. Add measurable success criteria to each deliverable. For the soak/chaos: sustained 30m soak at 1.2x normal 99th traffic, synthetic 10s spike, success if fallback <0.5%, 95p latency delta <25%, and KV miss multiplier <4x.
susan: Noted. We'll capture these metrics and dashboard them.
maria: For the scenario pack, include quantization/model permutations. Recommend smoke small model on presubmit, bigger permutations in nightly. I'll help define which models to include.
ben: Presubmit matcher will be conservative: trigger on changes touching kv, cache, routing, and rpc surfaces. Example globs: "src/serving/kv/**", "libs/cache/**", "src/router/*".
raj: Ops-bot, please create tracker items and link back to the postmortem doc. Make recurring reminders for the quarterly chaos and weekly regression ownership reviews.
ops-bot: Tasks created: RT-410 (scenario pack) owner: elaine due: 2026-04-15; RT-411 (promptset pack) owner: linda due: 2026-04-09; RT-412 (soak+chaos runbook) owner: susan due: 2026-04-11. Recurrences added: weekly regression review (owners: ben) and quarterly chaos execution (owner: susan). Links: https://tasks.internal/RT-410 https://tasks.internal/RT-411 https://tasks.internal/RT-412
elaine: I'll post the initial scenario YAMLs in RT-410 and ping ML reviewers for edge-case validation.
linda: Will include expected outputs and a short human-readable note per prompt.
ben: I'll add the sampled CI jobs and a gating job that runs a tiny scenario subset on PRs touching the globs. If infra is flaky, jobs annotate but don't block; we'll iterate.
maria: Also want a simple runbook for SREs describing how to triage regression diffs (common false positives + how to escalate). I'll draft and share in the task.
raj: Final ask: make sure the regression pack includes deterministic seeds and a reproducible runner so we can replay failures. Add a link to sample repros in the runbook.
susan: Will do. Dry run invite to staging and ML reviewers sent for Tue 2026-04-01 09:00 PT.
raj: Perfect. We'll reconvene after the dry run to lock on pass/fail thresholds and recurrence cadence. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
